exposure: Physical activity during pregnancy (evaluated by type, intensity, and energy expenditure)
outcome: conversion from vaginal delivery to cesarean section
cohort: The study included 226 nulliparous pregnant women with singleton pregnancies and no contraindications to physical activity, who participated in a physical activity survey and gave birth at the study hospital.
finding: A nonlinear relationship was observed between physical activity during pregnancy and the duration of the first stage of labor, with energy expenditure exceeding 142.28 MET-h*wk-1 associated with a decrease of 149.85 minutes in the first stage of labor per standard deviation increase.
